notes:
Virtual hosts: 19 built-in virtual hosts ship with BaoCut and appear in the Elements panel, with a picking table to choose one that fits the video. Character and Lottie sticker boxes are now sized by the character canvas or animation size instead of a fixed square.
Preview: Element layers composite within their own box, still pictures are read once per size instead of every frame, and the character renderer keeps texture sampling inlined in the preview, so editing previews stay smoother.
Voice cloning: Clone samples are checked for take quality, one microphone is kept across the clone steps, long Gemini samples are trimmed, references are converted to WAV before upload, and rejected clones show a diagnosis. Voice pickers let you fix a clone instead of graying it out.
Command line: A standalone baocut CLI package can be installed from the Skills page or with baocut cli install, serves MCP over stdio, adds baocut doctor, baocut update and baocut sandbox create, and reuses or replaces an idle Runtime of another version on the same home. Read-only accounts can be linked from another Runtime home. Version, status and doctor report stale builds. The Homebrew cask is generated from the macOS update feed.
Captions: The Classic caption style is back to white text by default. The production-scripts skill now turns the black caption edges off under dark narration text.
Web: The review page explains stale web builds.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Windows packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Automated release checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, or paid agent calls.
